data_description.temperature_entity: Room temperature sensor: sensor, input_number, number, weather or climate.
data_description.outdoor_entity: Optional. Without it the zone ignores the weather.
data_description.allowed_modes: Defines the modes offered by the zone (heating, cooling or both).
data_description.boiler_fraction_entity: Boiler power = heating power × fraction. Empty = 100 %.
data_description.season_entity: Auto mode: when on (summer) the zone cools, otherwise it heats. Empty = the sense follows the temperature (below the heating setpoint: heat; above the cooling setpoint: cool; in between: dead band).
data_description.associated_climate: Optional AC entity (e.g. Daikin) to view and control fan speed directly on this thermostat.

data.valve_position_entities: Actual valve position (same order as the valves)
data.valve_pending_entities: Command pending (same order as the valves)
data.valve_retry_minutes: Delay before resending an order to a valve
data.valve_keep_open: Keep open while no other zone requests heat
data.valve_min_step: Minimum difference before changing the opening

data_description.valve_entities: Opening number entities (e.g. …_valve_setpoint). Nothing is sent when cooling or in summer.
data_description.valve_position_entities: Optional: one sensor per valve (e.g. …_valve_position), in the same order as the valves above. Used to compare the real position with the setpoint sent.
data_description.valve_pending_entities: Optional: one binary sensor per valve (e.g. …_command_pending), in the same order as the valves. The zone waits for its valves (boiler power at 0 %) while ALL are pending, when a demand starts; as soon as one is not, the boiler is allowed. Safety: after 25 min of continuous waiting the boiler is allowed anyway.
data_description.valve_retry_minutes: After an order some battery valves take up to ~30 min to respond: the same order is not resent before this delay, then it is if the valve has not followed. A different order is sent right away.
data_description.valve_alert_minutes: If the real position stays more than 10 % away from the setpoint for this long, the 'Valve not following' indicator turns on. 0 = no alert. The delay restarts at each new order.
data_description.valve_source: Entity whose value (0-100 %) drives the opening: the zone's boiler or heating power, the boiler fraction, or any entity you like. Empty = the zone's boiler power.
data_description.valve_keep_open: When demand drops to 0 the valve stays as is unless another zone requests the boiler: it then goes to the "Valve closing" value. Disabled: "Valve closing" immediately.
data_description.valve_proportional: Enabled: opening follows demand between minimum and maximum. Disabled: the valve opens to the maximum opening as soon as the zone requests heat.
data_description.valve_close_level: Valve opening when the thermostat is off, and when another zone requests heat if "Keep open" is enabled (or when "Keep open" is disabled and demand drops to 0). 0 = fully closed.
data_description.valve_open_min: Proportional mode: lower limit (opening at 1 % demand). Empty = 0 %. Not used in fixed mode.
data_description.valve_open_max: Proportional mode: upper limit (opening at 100 % demand). Fixed mode: opening when the zone requests heat.
data_description.valve_min_step: The valve is only changed when the wanted opening differs from the current one by at least this percentage (full closing is always applied).

data_description.notify_service: Notification service to use (e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone). Empty = no notification. The list offers existing services; you can also type the name.
data_description.notify_message: Message sent at each new failure. Variables: $nom (entry name) and $cause (cause). Empty = '$nom : $cause'.
data_description.max_sensor_age: With no new sensor value for this long, the zone enters "sensor failure".
data_description.failsafe_power: 0 = the zone requests nothing when the sensor is missing.

data.offset_next_full: Reduction after a hot cycle (0 = off)

data_description.min_power: Below this percentage the zone requests nothing: avoids useless tiny demands.
data_description.limit_cycles: Once heating, the zone only stops below 1 % (instead of the minimum power).
data_description.autolearn: The zone tunes its own coefficients from the room's real temperature rise. Turn off to freeze them.
data_description.threshold_hot: If the previous cycle went above this percentage the radiator is still hot: the next cycle is reduced (see reduction below).
data_description.offset_next_full: Percentage removed from the next cycle after a very hot one, to account for radiator inertia. 0 = off.
data_description.fail_offset: If the zone heats (or cools) but the temperature stays more than X °C from the setpoint and keeps moving away, 2 cycles in a row: 'heating / cooling failure'.
data_description.cycle_minutes: Recalculation period of the percentage. Also the measurement window for learning.

data_description.windows: Opening sensors: the zone stops when one stays open.
data_description.window_stop_delay: How long a window stays open before the zone stops.
data_description.window_restart_delay: Delay after closing before regulation resumes.

data_description.burner_entity: Relay (switch) that turns the burner on.
data_description.circulator_entity: Circulator relay (switch), on as soon as there is demand.
data_description.power_sources: sensor / number / input_number entities: as soon as at least one source demands heat (> 0 %), the boiler regulates its water temperature.
data_description.boiler_fraction_entity: Optional. Boiler fraction entity (0-100 %) controlling the heating curve (water temperature between t_min and t_max). If left blank, automatic detection of fraction entry.
data_description.use_fraction: Enabled: water temperature follows heating curve based on boiler fraction (recommended with thermostatic valves). Disabled: water temperature follows summed zone demands.

data_description.post_run_minutes: 0 = circulator stops as soon as demand drops to 0.
data_description.min_on_minutes: The burner stays on at least this long (protects the boiler). Not applied on safety cut-off or zero demand.
data_description.min_off_minutes: The burner stays off at least this long before restarting.
data_description.safety_max: Above this water temperature the burner is cut.
data_description.water_max_age: With no new water sensor value for this long the burner is cut (water sensor failure).

data_description.climate_entity: The climate entity of the AC to control.
data_description.power_sources: sensor / number / input_number entities: a zone, or any other source you add.
data_description.cool_sources: Optional: cooling powers of the zones. Without them the AC only handles heating.
data_description.fraction_entity: The AC stops heating when this fraction reaches the cut-off. Empty = no cut-off.
data_description.summer_entity: When on (summer): the AC cools (if cooling sources are set), otherwise the manager leaves the AC alone.
data_description.defrost_power_entity: Power of the AC in W (e.g. sensor.salon_clim_reversible_electric_consumption_w). Without it, defrost detection is off.
data_description.defrost_outdoor_entity: Needed for defrost detection: no command is sent to the AC while it defrosts.

data_description.start_delay: Minimum time since the last change before switching the AC on.
data_description.adjust_interval: Minimum time between two setpoint changes.
data_description.ac_min_on: Minimum run time before switching off (protects the compressor).
data_description.mode_delay: Pause between the mode change and the setpoint.
data_description.defrost_min_power: Below this value the AC is idle (compressor stopped), not defrosting. Avoids mistaking standby for a defrost.
data_description.defrost_max_power: The AC is considered defrosting when its power is below this value (and heating, and outdoor temperature low enough).
data_description.defrost_max_outdoor: Defrost is only detected when the outdoor temperature is below this value (0 °C = below zero).
data_description.defrost_max_minutes: Safety: after this time the normal logic resumes, even if the sensors still look like a defrost.

data.min_fraction: Minimum fraction to use the boiler

data_description.source_entity: Temperature read live; yesterday's mean is computed from its history.
data_description.fallback_temperature: Used for a missing temperature (10 °C like the old template).
data_description.min_fraction: Below this percentage the fraction becomes 0 %: radiators would be too closed for the boiler to be useful (valves close, the AC takes over).
data_description.seuil_haut: Above this temperature: 0 % boiler. Between the two thresholds the fraction varies linearly.

data_description.hy_b_cycle: Boiler (slow base) re-evaluation period. Boiler power is held between cycles.
data_description.min_power: Below this, the boiler requests nothing.
data_description.hy_b_min_on: Once requested, the boiler is not cut before this delay (except Off, window or sensor failure).
data_description.hy_b_min_off: Once cut, the boiler is not requested again before this delay.
data_description.hy_b_hyst_on: Requests heat once the smoothed temperature is below setpoint by this value.
data_description.hy_b_hyst_off: Cuts when the smoothed temperature exceeds setpoint by this value. Minimum times override hysteresis.
data_description.hy_b_smooth: Moving average of the sensor for the boiler (high inertia). 0 = instantaneous.
data_description.hy_b_autolearn: At the end of each cycle, adjusts the boiler gain from the observed error. Unchecked: the gain no longer changes (manual setting only).

data.hy_a_force_fraction: Boiler fraction that forces AC on

data_description.hy_a_cycle: Fast loop period and AC learning window (10 min recommended).
data_description.autolearn: Adjusts AC reactivity from the observed temperature rise. Unchecked: it no longer changes (manual setting only).
data_description.hy_a_min_on: AC is not cut before this delay.
data_description.hy_a_min_off: AC is not requested again before this delay (unless forced by the boiler fraction).
data_description.hy_a_hyst_on: Requests heat once the temperature is below setpoint by this value.
data_description.hy_a_hyst_off: Cuts when the temperature exceeds setpoint by this value.
data_description.hy_a_smooth: Moving average of the sensor for the AC. 0 = instantaneous (reactive).
data_description.hy_a_force_fraction: When the boiler fraction reaches this threshold, the AC stays on (released 5 % lower). It still stops if the room exceeds setpoint by the turn-off hysteresis. 0 = disabled.
data_description.hy_a_force_power: AC power while held on by the boiler fraction.
